name: 44278 · Tallmadge, OH
findings: ZIP 44278 (Tallmadge) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44278 (Tallmadge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44278 (Tallmadge) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
